company: Butterfly Effect Pte. Ltd. (Manus / Manus AI)

ownership.quote: On June 15, however, Meta announced that it was officially cutting ties with Manus, citing Chinese regulators blocking the acquisition. ... On August 11, Manus announced it will operate as an independent company.

stage.quote: In April 2025, the company raised approximately US$75 million in a Series B round led by Benchmark, valuing the company at approximately US$500 million.
stage.note: Meta's Dec 2025 agreement to acquire Manus for >$2B was blocked by China's NDRC in April 2026 and unwound by Meta in June 2026; Manus resumed as an independent company in August 2026, so the last priced arm's-length financing round remains the April 2025 Series B (Benchmark), not the (unwound) Meta acquisition.

last_round.quote: In April 2025, the company raised approximately US$75 million in a Series B round led by Benchmark, valuing the company at approximately US$500 million.

revenue.basis: The Information, citing company-reported run rate
revenue.quote: In December 2025, the company reported that its revenue run rate had risen from approximately US$90 million in August to US$125 million.

note: Manus/Butterfly Effect is a Singapore-based (originally China-founded) AI agent company. Meta announced an acquisition (>$2B) in December 2025; China's NDRC blocked it in April 2026, Meta unwound the deal in June 2026, and Manus announced on 2026-08-11 it would resume as an independent company (matches the card's caveat). The 'Cloud Computer' persistent-VM rental product ($30/$50 monthly) is a small add-on to Manus's core agent product; most investor/revenue figures found relate to the whole company, not this specific VM-rental line.
